text:
lina-partnerships: FYI — TitanEdge (HW partner) is rejecting marketplace POs unless we attach a Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (MCO). Procurement says their portal/EDI doesn't support an extra attachment. :eyes:

mike-ops: ugh. Is this for the GPU rack SKUs only or all TitanEdge listings?

lina-partnerships: only the rack bundles for now (SKU TE-RACK-XL). They told our partner rep it's a compliance thing for their downstream resellers.

elaine-deals: procurement flagged that the marketplace EDI schema only supports standard PO fields. Attaching PDFs isn't supported in the async flow. They asked if TitanEdge can accept the standard PO and we email the MCO separately.

jordan-sales: Vendor refuses separate email — they want the MCO tied to the PO in the feed so their warehouse can release.

mike-ops: quick check — can we use a custom metadata field on the PO? I thought the marketplace supports free-form "notes" but not attachments.

elaine-deals: correct. Notes don't map to vendor EDI. If we add a metadata key it sits in our DB but TitanEdge's SFTP EDI job ignores it.

sachin-legal: legal POV: attaching an MCO is fine, but we need to ensure it doesn't change acceptance terms. If we start attaching third-party docs we should add an explicit clause that attachments don't amend the MSA. I'll draft a line.

lina-partnerships: can we get TitanEdge to accept SKU-level flag that warehouse reads? maybe a CSV column.

jordan-sales: they've pushed back — their fulfillment partner's parser is fixed and the parser only looks at PO number, qty, SKU, and payment terms.

mike-ops: short-term workaround: create a separate PO line with SKU "MCO-ATTACH" and quantity=1 and include a textual pointer to a signed MCO url in the line description. Example:```
PO: 2026-09-10-TE-12345
LINE: MCO-ATTACH x1
DESC: https://files.redwood.internal/titanedge/mco/TE-12345.pdf
```

elaine-deals: that might work operationally but procurement hates hacks like that; it will surface in billing reconciliation and trip invoice matchers.

sachin-legal: also need to review whether storing MCO at that URL meets retention/compliance — could be PII in some regions.

deploy-bot: Automated: New PO 2026-09-10-TE-12345 created by marketplace (status: pending). :robot_face:

lina-partnerships: Proposal: escalate — ask TitanEdge to accept one of two options: (A) accept standard PO and receive MCO via our secure SFTP attachment field (we'd extend EDI job) or (B) accept emailed verified MCO referenced by PO number.

jordan-sales: I'll loop in their vendor liaison. @sachin_legal can you draft the protective clause? @elaine-deals can you confirm what changes to EDI parser would cost / timeline?

elaine-deals: EDI parser change is a small engineering ticket but needs vendor coordination — estimate 2 sprints + vendor sign-off. If they want immediate fulfillment, we need the workaround.

sachin-legal: will draft clause today and send to Lina.

lina-partnerships: ok, thanks. I'll ping TitanEdge rep and propose those two options. If no answer by EOD tomorrow we'll move forward with the "MCO-ATTACH" line workaround and a reconciliation note. :thumbsup:

mike-ops: noted. tagging @oncall-fulfillment in case the workaround creates downstream alert noise.

lina-partnerships: thanks all — keeping this thread for audit.
